pretreatments.description: Thermal pretreatment was conducted for 30 min at 50 °C and 80 °C with a water bath (CW-10G, Jeio Tech), and at 120 °C with an autoclave (HAC-045, LK LabKorea).
Ultrasonic pretreatments was conducted for 30, 90, and 180 s on an ultrasonicator (VCX-130, Vibra-Cell) of 130 W.
Alkali pretreatment was adjusted to pH 9, 11, and 13 by 5 N NaOH.
Centrifugation (10 min, 3,000 rpm) was performed to separate solid and liquid phases before further BMP test.
Substrates were adjusted to 30 mL of distilled water for further BMP test after phase separation.
